term: literal reference on a fixed carrier
definition: The interpretation of the one name constant is an individual of the supplied Boolean carrier. SameSentences compares all Mathlib first-order sentences under the original and transported interpretations. ConsequenceAt compares truth-preservation at each interpretation for every finite premise list. AnchorRecovery requires both referents to satisfy one externally fixed DescriptionExists predicate; it does not establish that either satisfies it.
note: Analyst profile for #1073; attribution deferred. Predicate interpretation is transported in the isomorphism control. The external anchor is kept fixed. Applicability to actual language, epistemic access and identification of God remain OPEN.
